name: Freestone County Raceway
address: Off CR-995 near CR-996 and SR-246, Wortham, TX (no street number found)

soil.notes: Race coverage describes deep, sandy soil with a big sand section and loose sand throughout; owner added lots of sand for the 2011 national. One directory checklist says no sand, which conflicts with every race report.

layout.notes: Basically flat, wide and flowing with a few good jumps and a sand whoop section before the finish.

conditions.dry: Deep and sandy; heat (90s+) and wind are big factors.
conditions.late_day: Heavily watered early so even 450s bog; dries out to one main line by moto one, then multiple lines develop by moto two.
conditions.seasonal: Several practice dates a year but mainly open for events; hosted Pro nationals 2007-2012 and amateur spring championships.

rider_reports.says: Notebook: flat with deep sandy soil; over-watered morning so deep that 450s struggled, then one dry line in moto one and several lines by moto two; heat and 30 mph wind wore riders down.
Team report: loose sand, rough and rutted, 99F heat and gusty wind; a rut grabbed the front wheel late in moto one.
Practice report: owner dumped a lot of sand on it, making practice rough; sand whoops reshaped.

name: Lake Whitney Cycle Ranch

layout.notes: Former national (1970s-80s) and big amateur venue (spring/winter events into ~2010).

conditions.seasonal: Closed; forum posters (2024) say the land sits unused or is used privately for hunting.

rider_reports.says: Former racers recall back-section ruts so deep you picked one and went; called it a favorite track; it is now closed.
